description: DCA1000 raw-ADC streaming firmware (shipped_firmware/IWR1443/dca1000_raw): no on-chip processing, ADC over LVDS only. IWR1443 only (gui-30): prebuilt image xwr14xx_lvds_stream.bin; the 1843/6843 demos stream LVDS natively (lvdsStreamCfg).

lvds_data_fmts.source: shipped_firmware/IWR1443/dca1000_raw/iwr_raw_rosnode/firmware/xwr14xx_lvds_stream.bin is a prebuilt image with no source or doc in this repo; only dataFmt 0/1 are known (the shipped cfgs use 1); 4 not verified

n_tx.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 1: DS Table; max 2 simultaneous per chirp (SYS_14xx, RL:925)

band_subranges_ghz.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 3: a sweep must lie wholly inside one sub-band (RL:667-668)

max_slope_mhz_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 4: datasheet ramp rate (DS14 5.7 / DS18 7.7 / DS68 7.9); RL:710,713

max_sample_rate_ksps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 5: complex-1x, regular ADC mode (RL:742-757; IWR1843 12500 per datasheet IF 10 MHz, user ruling 2026-10-06)

lowpower_max_ksps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md (correction section; rl_sensor.h L742-767): applies only when the cfg selects low-power ADC mode (lowPower <x> 1); API doc, not datasheet

min_chirp_cycle_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 7: chirp cycle (idle + rampEnd) minimum, RL:651-654, RL:4570-4573; +10 us if the watchdog is on (xWR1xxx), not modelled

min_frame_blank_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 16: inter-frame blank typically >= 300 us (+150 us if the profile changes); RL:978-987

adc_buffer_bytes.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 9: SOC_XWR14XX_MSS_ADCBUF_SIZE 0x4000 (SYS14:312); DS14 diagram says 2x16KB, ping/pong split unresolved

lvds_lane_mbps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 12: DCA1000 max and demo/SAR program 0x9 = 600 (silicon allows 900)

channel_cfg_args.source: shipped single-chip cfgs: channelCfg rx tx cascading

hpf1_corner_khz.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E1: swrs211c s5.7 RF Specification fn (2) p.24-25; mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t hpfCornerFreq1 (index = code)

hpf2_corner_khz.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E1: swrs211c s5.7 RF Specification fn (2) p.24-25; mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t hpfCornerFreq2 (index = code)

rx_gain_min_db.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E3: swrs211c s5.7 RF Specification (max 48 dB, range 24 dB, step 2 dB); applies to rxGain bits 5:0 only

rx_gain_max_db.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E3: swrs211c s5.7 RF Specification (max 48 dB, range 24 dB, step 2 dB); applies to rxGain bits 5:0 only

rx_gain_step_db.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E2/E3: mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t rxGain 'all even values'; datasheet 'Gain step size 2 dB'

rx_gain_rf_target_db.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E3: mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t rxGain b7:6 (xWR1xxx table); index = rxGain bits 7:6, bits 7:6 are preserved on write-back

if_band_frac_complex1x.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

if_band_frac_complex2x.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

if_band_frac_real.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

complex1x_upper_half_is_positive_if.source: docs/research/gui_hpf_rxgain_2026-10-15.md E6: ar_baseband_appnote s3.1.2 Fig.5 (one-sided complex-1x spectrum 0..fs; a 2015 AR1243/1642 note, shared DFE assumed)

mimo.source: docs/research/gui_multichirp_tdm.md (c1ccf7a) section 2: raw binary, no parser, so no verified pattern rules

IWR1443.flash_hint: no firmware_dev project: prebuilt image, flash manually per shipped_firmware/README.md (SOP 101, flash, SOP 001, power-cycle)
IWR1443.note: source-derived (iwr_raw_rosnode lvds_stream/xwr14xx/cli.c:351, SDK 2.1 per binary strings); prompt LVDS Stream:/> required in the reply

detection_note: Raw-ADC capture firmware: it streams ADC data and runs no on-chip detection.
